summary: The w13 fixes are in, but most of them are only partly visible in the renders. Pixel diff against w13: q06 10 %, q07 20 %, q08 7 %, q09 12 %, q10 6 %; studio 1-11 %. What improved: (a) the cabinet and back panels beside the monitors now read greige (q06 back panel (174,166,152), w13 (188,183,174)), with crisper streaks in q07 (cabinet (185,177,164), hp 0.038 against w13 0.024 on my blur-4 metric); (b) the pillow check is softer and tone-on-tone at studio distance (r7); (c) the plaque now shows a grey margin round the lit field (q08 '13K'); (d) a buckle now shows at the strap end; (e) the O comforter holds its full width until the table corner. Six things still keep the area below 8.5. (1) The aisle-end doors and the cabinets still read the same tone in the aisle view: q06 door (173,170,165) against cabinet (174,166,152), a ratio of 1.0; in c_27312 the door is (209,207,198) and the cabinet (127,115,99), a ratio of 0.6. ashDoor still uses LAYER.ashGrain at gain 2.3, so the door leaves keep the strong dash streaks that ANA's photos do not show. (2) The buckle is a 5 x 3.5 cm flat pale-grey tile that reads as a label. In kn_17 and tpg_46 it is a large polished chrome buckle (~7 x 5 cm) with a lift lever. The latch half sits under the pillow and does not show. (3) The bundle duvet is still an opaque lilac slab with no film (r7 0.61/0.66/0.91 of the white pillow; kn_17 0.41/0.49/0.76). There is no crinkle or specular film geometry. (4) The pillows are still rigid, evenly radiused foam slabs, and the white pillow reads as a seat cushion. (5) The O comforter is still a crisp-edged T made of flat sheet, with almost no drape (foldK 0.2, wob 0.25). (6) In the cabin views the pillow reads violet-royal (q08 R/G 0.83, B/G 2.27) rather than kn_17's navy (R/G 0.69, B/G 1.92). Lighting (not scored): the shells read light slate in q10 ((125,131,140) against c_27315 (75-97)), while the seat fabric matches ((93,95,109) against (95,91,103)).

issues.detail: The aisle-end doors still read the same tone as the cabinets, and still carry strong dash grain
issues.problem: The colour split exists in code, but in the aisle view the door leaves and the monitor-side cabinets render at equal luminance. The door leaves also show the same high-gain dash streaks as the cabinets, because ashDoor uses LAYER.ashGrain (PHOTO_GAIN 2.3). In c_27312 and c_27313 the door leaf is a pale, almost plain cream panel in a dark frame, clearly lighter than the cabinet beside it (ratio ~0.6).
issues.fix: 03_tex.js (shared, one line each): add LAYER ashDoor: 30, alias L[30] = L[19] (same j_ash tile), PHOTO_GAIN 30: 0.9, LAYER_PARAMS 30 = LAYER_PARAMS 19. Then in 09c line 25: ashDoor { c: '#e6dfd2', r: 0.44, l: LAYER.ashDoor }. To open the tonal gap, darken SEATMAT.ash '#c8bba7' -> '#b5a690' (09_seats.js, shared). Targets: q06 door >= 195, cabinet <= 150.

issues.detail: Buckle reads as a small flat grey label, not a chrome buckle; the latch half does not show
issues.problem: The buckle at 09c:69 is gRBox(0.05, 0.012, 0.035) in matte-looking light grey. kn_17 (lower right) and tpg_46 (both seats) show a large polished buckle (~0.07 x 0.05 m) with a raised lift lever, clearly the brightest point on the cushion. The latch half (09c:70, CU (-0.20, 0.02)) is buried under the pillow and bundle in every view. kn_17 shows it on the open cushion beside the slipper pack.
issues.evidence: r7 zoom: a grey tile at the strap end. q09 zoom (460-500 x 85-110): reads as a white tag. kn_17 (1020-1150 x 730-820) is a chrome buckle with lever and dark shading; tpg_46 (280-330 x 820-860) is white-silver.
issues.fix: 09c:69: gRBox(0.07, 0.014, 0.05, 0.006, 1), plus a lever gRBox(0.045, 0.006, 0.03, 0.003, 1) at +0.010 y, both SEATMAT.buckle. In 09_seats.js (shared) set buckle r 0.25 -> 0.15. Move the latch half to CU (0.22, 0.048, 0.10, 0.6), on the open cushion beside the slipper pack (kn_17), with a 0.12 m stub of dark webbing #2c4250 running to the seat crease.

issues.detail: Boarding-bundle duvet still pale and opaque, with no film
issues.problem: The colour change to #4f5899 does not show: at r 0.22 the top face catches the key light, and the slab reads lilac. There are no film creases or highlights, so it does not read as 'in plastic' the way kn_17 and tpg_46 do.
issues.fix: 09c:279: c '#3d4688', r 0.55 (the matte cloth under the film). Add the film as 4-5 thin bright crease strips: for k in 0..4, gBox(0.40, 0.0015, 0.006) rotated ±(10-25) deg about y at y 0.508, { c: '#f4f6fa', r: 0.08 }. Add a 2 mm wider gRBox shell { c: '#dfe4ee', r: 0.06, a: 0.2 } if the alpha path allows it.

issues.detail: Pillows are rigid foam slabs; the white pillow reads as a seat cushion
issues.problem: In the photos the pillows sag, pinch to dog-eared corners and lean back on the bundle (tpg_46 ~60 deg; kn_17). The model has uniform-thickness, evenly radiused slabs stood nearly upright.
issues.fix: 09c roomPillow: replace the cushionSecs loft with a 32x24 grid displaced by T(u,v) = 0.05 * (1 - |2u-1|^4) * (1 - |2v-1|^4)^0.6 + 0.004 on each face, so the corners pinch to ~8 mm, plus 2 sine wrinkles (A 0.003). Tilt both seat pillows back a further 15-20 deg so they lean on the bundle as in tpg_46.

issues.detail: O comforter: crisp-edged flat T with almost no drape
issues.problem: The outline is now wider, but the edges are straight cuts and the cloth is nearly flat (foldK 0.2, wob 0.25 for O). tpg_81 shows a loose diagonal spread with irregular edges, 3-4 broad drapes and a heap where it enters the footwell.
issues.fix: 09c:388: for O, foldK 0.2 -> 0.45 and wob 0.25 -> 0.8. In the O bounds, soften the step: a = smooth(-0.72, -0.52, z), and add 0.03 * sin(9 * z + 1.3) to xr. Add a footwell heap in fold(): f += 0.03 * smooth(zf - 0.15, zf, z) * (1 - smooth(zf, zf + 0.25, z)) when zf !== null.
